name: 20 minute-bar paper strategies catalog (entry/exit templates)
one_line: Forward paper test of 20 templates on BTC/ETH 1-minute bars; no results documented yet.

source.license: no LICENSE file in repo; owner's own repository (owner-provided reference, do not redistribute)

idea: Templates: HA 3-candle trend, EMA9/21 cross, EMA20/50 pullback, MACD 12/26/9, RSI reversal, Bollinger re-entry, Donchian20 breakout (2 ATR initial, 2.5 ATR trail, opposite 10-bar exit), VWAP reclaim, ATR trend band, Keltner 1.5 ATR, BB squeeze release, stochastic reversal, OBV confirmation, taker imbalance, funding extremes, ATR range expansion.
rationale: Breadth of simple rule templates measured under identical cost assumptions.
evidence: None documented (state kept in a JSON file outside the repo). Source states a short winning regime is not sufficient evidence.

pipeline_fit.notes: Useful as a checklist of exit designs (ATR initial/trailing stop, opposite-channel exit). ATR trailing stops are the rule type that was silently dead in a previous run: always give them their own rule name.
